title: Pure Vaylantz
summary: Pure Vaylantz tactical grid strategy, moving Scale 1 Pendulum Monsters across the board like miniature wargame pieces between columns. Shifting zones triggers precision searches, destructive bounces, and Fusion Summons while locking opposing monsters into the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells.

summary.title: Starters
points: Shinonome the Vaylantz Priestess Special Summons itself from the Pendulum Zone into the same column, and adds a Vaylantz Spell from Deck to hand when moved to another Monster Zone.

Vaylantz Wars - The Place of Beginning searches a Vaylantz Field Spell and Senet Switch from your Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to place a face-up Vaylantz Pendulum from the Extra Deck into your Pendulum Zone.
Vaylantz Wakening - Solo Activation places a Vaylantz Pendulum Monster from your Deck directly into your Pendulum Zone, and banishes itself from the GY to move a monster to an adjacent zone.
Vaylantz Buster Baron Special Summons itself from the Pendulum Zone and targets another monster you control to move it to an adjacent Monster Zone.
Beyond the Pendulum searches any Pendulum Monster from your Deck upon Link Summon and destroys 2 cards on the field when two monsters with different Levels are Pendulum Summoned.

summary.title: Opening: Shinonome Grid Shift
steps: Place Shinonome the Vaylantz Priestess in your Pendulum Zone and activate its effect to Special Summon itself to the Main Monster Zone in the same column.
Shinonome triggers on summon, adding Vaylantz Wars - The Place of Beginning from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Vaylantz Wars, destroying a card to add Vaylantz World - Shinra Bansho and Senet Switch to your hand.
Activate Senet Switch and use it to move Shinonome to an adjacent Monster Zone.
Shinonome triggers upon moving, searching Hojo the Vaylantz Warrior (or Nazuki) from your Deck to hand.
Place Hojo in the Pendulum Zone, summon it, and move it to trigger its in-archetype Fusion Summon.

summary.title: The Dual Field World & Column Control
points: Vaylantz World - Shinra Bansho places Vaylantz World - Konig Wissen face-up into the opponent's Field Zone, and allows either player to Special Summon a Monster Card from their Spell & Trap Zone.
Vaylantz World - Konig Wissen places Shinra Bansho into the opponent's Field Zone, and pushes an opponent's monster into their Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell.

All Main Deck Vaylantz monsters are Scale 1 Pendulums that Special Summon themselves to the same column while you control no monsters or only Vaylantz monsters, locking you into Vaylantz Special Summons except from the Extra Deck.
Senet Switch manually moves a monster you control to an adjacent unoccupied Main Monster Zone once per turn, repeatedly triggering Vaylantz movement effects.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Mamonaka the Vaylantz United is a Fusion boss made from 3 Vaylantz monsters that takes control of an opponent's monster during their turn as a Quick Effect by placing it into their Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
Arktos XII - Chronochasm Vaylantz is a Level 12 Fusion that swaps the locations of two monsters on the field as a Quick Effect and destroys a card on the field whenever a monster changes columns.

Vaylantz Genesis Grand Duke can be Special Summoned from the Extra Deck by sending 1 non-Fusion Vaylantz monster from your field, returns a card from the Spell & Trap Zone to hand, and burns for its ATK.
Vaylantz Wave - Master Phase is a Continuous Trap that boosts your Level 5+ Vaylantz monsters or locks an opponent's card in their Spell & Trap Zone whenever a monster changes columns.
